manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the left arm to set the rounded can with smooth printed surface in the medium-sized basket with perforated texture; another arm lifts the medium-sized basket with perforated texture.

Task description: Use the left arm to place the smooth brown cylindrical can with a printed pattern on the left of the table into the yellow perforated medium basket at the center. Then use the right arm to lift the basket so the can rises with it.

Success criteria: The can body is inside the basket, near and physically touching it, and no longer touching the table. The right arm lifts the basket, with both basket and can clearly above their initial positions, the opening upward, and no excessive sideways tilt.

## Execution tips

- The round can is smooth. With the left gripper, grasp opposing sides around the middle, avoiding the rolled top and bottom rims, and open slightly wider than the body. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides to avoid pushing it over from one side or slipping.
- The right gripper can grasp a continuous solid upper rim on the basket side nearer the right arm, with one finger inside and one outside. Avoid holes and handle attachments to obtain reliable contact while leaving space to insert the can.
- The black handle occupies part of the basket opening. When moving the can inside, choose an area not blocked by the handle, leaving clearance for both the can and left gripper to avoid catching the handle or hitting the rim.
- While the basket is suspended, minimize shaking and tilt of the right arm. Adjust the can’s approach position based on the basket opening’s live position, avoiding placement based on its earlier position that could hit a side wall.
- Release the left gripper only after the jar base is supported by the basket bottom, then withdraw through the basket opening, avoiding a tip-over from suspended release or catching the rim while withdrawing.
